catalog.persistence: local SQLite survives CLI restart; environment persistence and production backups are not guaranteed
catalog.scope_security: explicit logical scope in every keyword operation; CLI is a trusted local operator tool, not an authenticated customer API

geography.source_format: local UTF-8 GeoNames standard 19-field country TSV
geography.source_license_expected: CC BY 4.0; actual input license and source version must be supplied and reviewed
geography.completeness: unverified populated-place candidates, not all official cities or municipalities
geography.canonical_slug: country/name-geonames_id; assigned slug survives later source-name changes
geography.coverage_approval: verified service capability and owner evidence required before a separate controlled publication process

keyword_measurement.monthly_period: YYYY-MM; measured_estimate requires a complete month before the observation timestamp
top_ten_gate: at least ten designated main keywords
nonmissing measured_estimate volume for every included cohort record
no range or unavailable metrics in the cohort
explicit intent and cluster for every included cohort record
secondary relations resolve to a main keyword in the same cohort
keyword_measurement.ranking: descending source monthly estimate with deterministic normalized-keyword tie break
keyword_measurement.google_ads_metrics: approximate source metrics, including monthly values; access depends on an authorized account and source capability

workflow.required: dated primary sources, candidate market/language, business offer and relevant customer questions
comparable source cohort, documented metric quality and no missing values disguised as zero
main/secondary relation, customer intent, avoid unrelated keyword targets
review measured top ten, actual offer and service coverage; approve relevant page purpose
unique useful local information and evidence; no invented offices or cloned city-doorway intent
approved brief, grounded claims, DE/NL/FR scope and existing price/legal authority
source/readback, factual and language checks, useful page distinction, accessibility and release evidence
existing concrete authorization and live release gates; no publishing capability supplied by staging CLI

geo_optimization.meaning: generative engine optimization is distinct from geographic city research

provenance_note: Official-source research is handled separately; URLs here identify import/provider contracts and do not claim successful authenticated data retrieval. No numeric keyword volumes or complete official city lists are invented.
